observations: Two small white desktop speakers (left and right) with black circular drivers.
Brand text “logi” visible on photo 0 and photo 1 (bottom left speaker).
Right speaker has a blue LED lit and a volume/knob area visible (photo 1).
Close-up label on photo 2 shows: “2207 Right Speaker Sound Wall Bluetooth” and “Models: 001108”.
Photo 2 label also shows power/input info including “Input 6V == 1.5A” and regulatory markings (FCC/IC).

claims.claim: Great condition with powerful clean sound.
claims.evidence: No audio test/video or functional demonstration shown in the photos.

claims.claim: Can be used with your laptop or other devices for good...
claims.evidence: No connection method shown (Bluetooth pairing screen, AUX/USB ports, or included cables).

risks.risk: Not fully functional (one speaker may be dead, distorted, or low volume) even if the LED is on.
risks.proof: A short video showing both speakers playing the same audio at low and mid volume (and ideally bass) from a phone/laptop.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not guaranteed working (worst case: needs repair or one side weak).

risks.risk: Bluetooth pairing may fail or have range issues.
risks.proof: Clip showing the phone/laptop Bluetooth pairing to the speaker and playing audio successfully.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as Bluetooth not guaranteed (worst case: only works via unknown method or not at all).

risks.risk: Missing accessories/cables (power adapter, charging cable, AUX cable) or wrong adapter voltage.
risks.proof: Photo of everything included laid out + close-up of the exact power adapter model/specs (or proof the speaker powers on with the provided adapter).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as may require buying missing accessories.

risks.risk: Physical damage not obvious in photos (cracked driver, loose wiring, buzzing).
risks.proof: Close-up of both drivers and a quick tap/bass test video showing no rattling/buzzing.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as cosmetically okay but functionality not confirmed.

proof_requests: Video test: play audio from a laptop/phone showing both speakers working (left + right) with volume changes.
Show Bluetooth pairing: screen recording or photo of the device connected to the speaker.
Photo of included items (power adapter/cables) and close-up of adapter specs; confirm the speaker powers on with it.
Close-up of both speaker backs/ports and any model/port labels (to confirm inputs like AUX/USB).
response.reason: The photos identify the speakers as a logi Bluetooth desktop speaker set (model info visible on the label), but the seller’s “powerful clean sound” and device compatibility are not proven. A quick audio + pairing test is needed to price confidently.
